messages.content: Before the Kauai holds expire, verify the final amounts including tax and every rental charge. I also want the cancellation terms and a timing check for arrival and departure before you issue anything.

I have the final checkout figures. The nonstop flights for two are $1,418.40 including airline taxes and fees. Koloa Bay Resort is $4,447.97 including room tax and the resort assessment. The rental checkout adds a $61.16 airport concession recovery charge to the earlier $548.20 quote, making the car $609.36. The complete trip total is therefore $6,475.73.
So the only increase is $61.16 on the car? There is not another tax collected when we pick it up?

Correct. The $609.36 rental total includes the base rate, state and county taxes, facility charges, and the airport concession recovery charge. It remains an estimate only because fuel, tolls, optional products, late return, or damage charges would be additional. With the reservation returned on time and no extras accepted, there is no other mandatory amount due at pickup.
Now give me the cancellation rules separately. Start with the flights.

The airfare is not refundable to the original payment method after the airline's 24-hour cancellation window. If canceled within 24 hours of purchase, it can be refunded without penalty. After that, the tickets may be canceled before departure for airline credit, subject to the fare rules; a missed flight without prior cancellation forfeits the value.
And the room and car? Be precise about the local deadline on the room.

The oceanfront king can be canceled without penalty through June 3, 2028 at 6:00 p.m. Hawaii time. After that deadline, the $1,270.85 deposit is nonrefundable. The pay-later rental can be canceled without charge any time before the scheduled pickup; no prepayment is taken today.
Check the schedule against the rental counter and the hotel. I do not want to land after the desk closes or have the car due before we can reasonably leave the resort.

The June 10 nonstop leaves SFO at 9:10 a.m. and arrives at LIH at 11:46 a.m. The rental desk is open from 5:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m., so the scheduled arrival leaves more than eleven hours before closing. Koloa Bay check-in begins at 4:00 p.m.; after baggage claim and pickup, you should reach the resort around 1:15 p.m., so the room may not yet be ready. The resort can hold luggage until check-in.
What about June 17? Include hotel checkout, the car return, and the flight time.

Hotel checkout is 11:00 a.m. The car is reserved through 11:30 a.m., and the return flight departs LIH at 1:05 p.m. Because the rental return and terminal security need more time, leaving the resort around 9:15 a.m. is the practical plan. That should put you at the rental return near 9:45, well before both the 11:30 return deadline and the flight.
That works. Complete all three at those final amounts. Do not add rental insurance or other counter products.

All three bookings are complete for June 10-17, 2028. The nonstop flights for two are ticketed under H7K2QM at $1,418.40; the 24-hour cancellation window ends tomorrow at 8:42 p.m. Pacific time. Koloa Bay Resort's oceanfront king is confirmed under KB8F41 at $4,447.97, with a $1,270.85 deposit charged and refundable through June 3 at 6:00 p.m. Hawaii time. The midsize rental is confirmed under LIH6R28 at an estimated $609.36, payable at pickup and cancelable before pickup. No optional rental products were added. The final projected trip total is $6,475.73.
